== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Jeroen Webb (Japanese)|Jeroen Webb]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940002/3OP4xq4Z9UCcH6LMp6k6Lg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099777.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d1b95a4a5b6ed39ac23e3c3c8049b71df2f137e20cc93e1216ce270e4447e7e3</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
